B.domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification to lowest terms

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite unlike fractions as equivalent fractions before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same
Do not tag when a fraction is only simplified or normalized without creating equivalent fractions to a common denominator
Do not tag borrowing steps

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible standard form for subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus a zero fraction
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to an equivalent standard mixed number
Tag when a mixed number is simplified by reducing its fractional part before subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary common-denominator conversions between simple fractions
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part during subtraction
Do not tag final simplification of the answer unless it is used to rewrite an operand before subtraction

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator
Tag when the same-denominator fraction subtraction occurs after a common-denominator conversion
Tag when the fraction result is zero because equal numerators are subtracted
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag whole-number subtraction by itself
Do not tag the step of finding the common denominator
Do not tag borrowing itself, though tag the later fraction subtraction after borrowing if shown

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of mixed numbers or whole numbers as a separate part of the computation.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 2
Tag when a solution keeps or updates the whole-number part while working with mixed-number subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-only items with no whole-number component
Do not tag borrowing adjustments unless the step explicitly performs whole-part subtraction or reduction
Do not tag final combination steps that merely state the answer

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the subtrahend's fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part
Tag when a whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the existing fractional part
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary normalization of a whole number as a whole plus zero fraction before any need to borrow
Do not tag fraction subtraction after borrowing unless the borrowing action itself is shown
Do not tag cases where no regrouping is needed

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Express the result in lowest terms and combine whole and fractional parts into a final integer, fraction, or mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction result is reduced to lowest terms
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0 or a whole number
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into a mixed number or final single value
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet formed the final result
Do not tag operand simplification done before subtraction; that belongs to normalization
Do not tag common-denominator conversion

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtraction.
Tag for both pure-fraction items and mixed-number items whose fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simple simplification of a fraction such as 4/10 to 2/5 unless it is part of creating a common denominator.
Do not tag borrowing steps.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole or mixed-number operand into a subtraction-ready form, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or writing a whole number as a mixed number with zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator, such as 3 to 3 + 0/5.
Tag when an operand is reformatted so whole and fractional parts can be subtracted separately.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary equivalent-fraction conversion for matching denominators.
Do not tag borrowing after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag final recombination of whole and fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator.
Tag when same-denominator fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when the same-denominator subtraction occurs after a prior conversion or borrowing step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that finds or creates the common denominator.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction unless subtraction itself is shown.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the minuend and subtrahend when working with mixed numbers or rewritten whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts, such as 4 − 3 = 1.
Tag when whole-part subtraction is done alongside fraction-part subtraction in the same step.
Tag when a whole number is treated as the whole part of a mixed number and then subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction subtraction with no whole-number components.
Do not tag borrowing adjustments unless the step explicitly performs the whole-part subtraction itself.
Do not tag final combination statements that merely report the mixed-number result.

skills.name: Borrow across mixed number
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as fractional units when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the subtrahend’s fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it into denominator-over-denominator fractional units.
Tag when the solution changes a negative fractional difference into a positive one by regrouping.
Tag when borrowing is used in mixed-number minus mixed-number, whole minus fraction, or mixed-number minus fraction problems.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag final simplification after borrowing.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, or integer.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is simplified, such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer.
Tag when the final answer form removes a zero whole part or zero fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction step itself unless the step also explicitly simplifies or combines the result.
Do not tag rewriting an operand before subtraction.
Do not tag finding a common denominator.
